# Complete `_quarto.yml` configuration {.appendix #sec-yaml-config-file}

This appendix reproduces and comments on the `_quarto.yml` file in its entirety,
for quick reference.

## Document metadata for the cover page

```yaml
book:
  title: "Thesis title"
  subtitle: "Optional subtitle"        # remove if absent
  author: "First LAST"
  downloads: [pdf]                     # PDF button in the HTML sidebar

date-soutenance: "12 June 2026"        # DO NOT use date:
discipline: "60th CNU section — Mechanics, mechanical engineering, civil engineering"
specialite: "Acoustics"
ecole-doctorale: "Sciences des Métiers de l'Ingénieur"
laboratoire: "MACS Laboratory, Cnam Paris"
directeur: "Prof. First LAST, Full Professor, Cnam Paris"
cotutelle: false

dedicace: "Optional dedication…"       # remove if absent
```

## Jury composition for the cover page

```yaml
jury:
  - nom: "Ms First LAST"
    titre: "Title, Research Unit, Institution"
    role: "Chair"
  - nom: "Mr First LAST"
    titre: "Title, Research Unit, Institution"
    role: "Reviewer"
  - nom: "Ms First LAST"
    titre: "Title, Research Unit, Institution"
    role: "Reviewer"
  - nom: "Mr First LAST"
    titre: "Associate Professor HDR, Unit, Institution"
    role: "Examiner"
  - nom: "Mr First LAST"
    titre: "Full Professor, MACS, Cnam Paris"
    role: "Thesis supervisor"
```

## Infrastructure section options

```yaml
glossaire: true          # true = loads the LaTeX glossaries package
pagestyle-sections: true # true = roman/arabic/Roman numbering per section
bibliography-manual: true
minitoc-newpage: false   # true = page break after each mini-TOC
chapter-openright: true  # false = for digital version without right-hand page
index: false             # true = generates an index via \index{term}
```

## Collaborative comments

```yaml
comments:
  enabled: true          # false before final deposit on theses.fr
  show_author: true
  authors:
    author:
      name: "First LAST"
      color_html: "#005EA5"
      color_latex: "blue!20"
    supervisor:
      name: "Supervisor"
      color_html: "#D55E00"
      color_latex: "orange!30"
```

## Python execution

```yaml
execute:
  freeze: auto    # recomputes only if the chunk code changes
  echo: true      # shows code by default (overridable per chunk)
```

# PDF/A-1b submission on theses.fr {.appendix #sec-pdfa}

The French national thesis repository **theses.fr** requires a PDF/A-1b file
conforming to ISO 19005-1. The PDF produced directly by `pdflatex` has known
violations related to Quarto callouts and matplotlib figures — these are corrected
by a Ghostscript post-processing step.

## Sources of non-compliance

| Violation | Origin | GS treatment |
|:---|:---|:---|
| §6.4 transparency | `opacityback=0` in tcolorbox callouts | Flattened to opaque |
| §6.4 transparency | `alpha < 1.0` in matplotlib figures | Flattened to opaque |
| §6.3.5/§6.3.6 fonts | FontAwesome5 metrics (callout icons) | Re-embedded |
| §6.3.5/§6.3.6 fonts | DejaVu Type 3 (matplotlib axis labels) | Converted/removed |

## Installing Ghostscript

Ghostscript is **not included** in TeX Live — it must be installed separately.

::: {.callout-note}
## Installation by platform

**macOS:**
```bash
brew install ghostscript
```

**Linux (Debian/Ubuntu):**
```bash
apt install ghostscript
```

**Linux (Fedora/RHEL):**
```bash
dnf install ghostscript
```

**Windows:**
```powershell
winget install ArtifexSoftware.GhostScript
```
:::

## Submission workflow

The PDF/A-1b conversion is activated by adding `pdfa` as a third argument in
`_quarto-en.yml` (or `_quarto-fr.yml`):

```yaml
# In _quarto-en.yml — for final submission only:
project:
  post-render:
    - ./_scripts/postrender.sh en _thesis-en pdfa
    # Windows: ./_scripts/postrender.bat en _thesis-en pdfa
```

Then render the PDF:

```bash
quarto render --profile en --to cnam-thesis-pdf
```

The script prints sizes before and after:

```
Running Ghostscript PDF/A-1b conversion…
PDF/A-1b conversion done: 835 KB → 1403 KB
Validate on pdfforge.org before submitting to theses.fr.
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## Mandatory validation before deposit

Upload the converted PDF to **[pdfforge.org](https://www.pdfforge.org/pdfcreator/features/pdfa-validator)**
to verify compliance before submitting to theses.fr.
Ghostscript corrects most violations but does not guarantee 100% compliance
in all edge cases.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## After submission

Restore the line without `pdfa` in `_quarto-en.yml` for day-to-day builds —
GS conversion adds approximately 1–2 minutes of processing and is only needed
for the final deposit.
:::

## File size increase

Conversion causes a size increase of approximately **60–70%** for a document
with matplotlib figures using transparency (grids with `alpha < 1`).
This is inherent to vector transparency flattening.
To minimise it, use opaque colours directly in matplotlib:

```python
# Instead of:   ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.grid(True, color='lightgray')   # visual equivalent, no transparency
```
